meta.homeTitle: TabNow: every tab, one keystroke away
meta.homeDescription: TabNow is a fast fuzzy finder for your open tabs. Press Alt+E (Cmd+E on a Mac), type a few letters, hit Enter. Searches every window, private by design, open source.
meta.ogAlt: TabNow, a fuzzy finder for your open browser tabs

install.soon: Coming soon to the Chrome Web Store

hero.subtitle: A fuzzy finder for your open tabs. Press Alt+E (Cmd+E on a Mac), type a few letters, hit Enter.

demo.label: Live demo of the TabNow finder

fuzzy.text: Type gh pr and get the pull request. Domain first, then title.

windows.text: All open windows in one list. Bookmarks and history join in when you turn them on, with /b and /h.

back.text: <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Z</kbd> jumps to the previous tab without opening anything.

themes.text: TabNow follows your system, or you pick. <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> switches on the spot.

keys.lead: On a Mac, Cmd+E opens the finder.

privacy.lead: The extension has no account, no analytics and no servers. Plain JavaScript, open source under MIT.
privacy.permsTitle: What it asks the browser for

perms.name: tabs
perms.text: Read titles and addresses of open tabs, so you can search them.

perms.name: activeTab
perms.text: Show the finder on the page you are on.

perms.name: scripting
perms.text: Put the finder on that page.

perms.name: storage
perms.text: Remember your settings on this device.

perms.name: bookmarks
perms.text: Only if you turn on /b. The browser asks first.

perms.name: history
perms.text: Only if you turn on /h. Last 90 days, searched locally.

installSection.lead: Works in Chrome 121+, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Arc.
installSection.leadSoon: Works in Chrome 121+, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Arc. In the Microsoft Edge Add-ons store now, the Chrome Web Store is coming soon.
steps: Open TabNow in the Chrome Web Store.
Press Alt+E on any page. On a Mac, Cmd+E. Change it at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.
